sources.title: NVIDIA VoiceChat-11B Brings Full-Duplex AI Speech to Real-Time Agents
sources.snippet: NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-VoiceChat-11B is an 11-billion parameter end-to-end full duplex speech model developed by nvidia that performs streaming speech understanding and generation in a single unified architecture.
